construction_scope: enumerate every reachable seven-card name multiset for each exact 60 by bounded card counts; no RNG
reproduce the accepted Monster denominator exactly and construct the previously-unfrozen Pest denominator
derive M0-M4 and bottom-order sensitivity only from submitted-list and visible-hand facts
look up M5 only by the already-accepted exact public atom key; absent atoms remain null/unknown
compress physical bottom coverage only by accepted handle-renaming symmetry; preserve a deterministic count/hash specification for distinct land order and equal-CMC spell-order classes
emit the complete set/hash of unbanked public M5 atom keys before any keep/bottom parity execution
prohibited: no assumed truth for an unbanked atom
no keep/bottom parity claim from construction alone
no historical narrow case promoted to whole-pair authority
no seed, allocation, claim or gameplay
next_gate: Independently audit the constructed finite bank geometry and unbanked-atom closure. If Pest has unbanked non-forced M5 atoms, qualify those public atoms prospectively before any whole-bank keep/bottom parity run; otherwise freeze the exact comparator bank.
